name: Grýla
body:
GRÝLA
CR 13

This hideous woman mixes features of trolls and wintry hags. She carries a sack slung over her hunched back.

XP 25,600
CE Large humanoid (giant)
Init +5; Senses darkvision 60 ft., detect evil, low-light vision, scent; Perception +31

DEFENSE

AC 28, touch 14, flat-footed 23 (+5 Dex, +14 natural, ?1 size)
hp 178 (17d8+102); regeneration 10 (acid or fire)
Fort +16, Ref +12, Will +12
Defensive Abilities limited immortality; DR 10/cold iron; Immune cold, paralysis; SR 24

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee bite +22 (2d6+10), 2 claws +22 (1d8+10 plus grab)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks capture, rend (2 claws, 1d8+15)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 17th; concentration +17)

Constant—detect evil

STATISTICS

Str 31, Dex 20, Con 23, Int 10, Wis 20, Cha 11
Base Atk +12; CMB +23 (+25 bull rush, +27 grapple); CMD 38 (40 vs. bull rush)
Feats Enforcer, Improved Bull Rush, Intimidating Prowess, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Power Attack, Skill Focus (Perception), Weapon Focus (bite, claw)
Skills Intimidate +30, Perception +31
Languages Giant

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Capture (Su)

If Grýla begins her turn grappling a Medium or smaller creature, she can stuff the target into her bag as a swift action that doesn’t provoke attacks of opportunity. A creature in the bag can try to cut its way free with any light slashing weapon. The bag has AC 20, hardness 20, and 20 hit points. If a creature cuts its way out of the bag, Grýla can repair the bag as a full-round action that provokes attacks of opportunity. Until then, any creature stuffed into the bag can escape with a move action that provokes an attack of opportunity from Grýla. The bag has other special qualities while in Grýla’s possession. The weight of creatures in the bag doesn’t count against Grýla’s carrying capacity. Up to four Small creatures or two Medium creatures can fit in the bag at a time.

If used by any creature other than Grýla, the container functions as a mundane sack. If Grýla’s bag is lost or destroyed, she can create a new bag with 1 hour of work.

Limited Immortality (Su)

Though Grýla still needs to eat, drink, and sleep, she doesn’t age and can’t die of old age.

If Grýla is killed, a new Grýla forms elsewhere in the world after a year’s time—this new Grýla retains the memories of the previous Grýla and likely holds a grudge against the person who killed her the year before. If a method to disrupt this cycle exists, it has yet to be discovered by mortals.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary (unique), pair (Grýla and Leppaluoi, who has the same stats but doesn’t have the capture special attack), or family (Grýla, Leppaluoi, 13 yule lads, 1 yule cat)
Treasure double

Grýla fills a similar niche to the considerably more wellknown and powerful Krampus. She appears during winter festival seasons to capture naughty children in her sack and uses her innate senses to discern if her potential captives are truly rotten to the core. These children, properly cooked alive and placed into a stew, provide her with sustenance where no other meals can. Parents with unruly children whisper entreaties to Grýla to remove the recalcitrant brats from their lives. Though she attempts to subdue her future meals rather than outright kill them, which would ruin their flavor, for those who decide to protect the children due for Grýla’s stewpot, she uses her size and foul demeanor to drive away these protectors.

She also has no compunction about lethally attacking people she doesn’t plan to eat and makes a grand display of chewing her targets with her massive maw.

Grýla is usually accompanied by her thirteen sons, known as the Yule Lads, and a giant cat, nicknamed the Yule Cat. She has had several husbands and many children over the years. Her current mate is named Leppalúði and rarely travels with her. He instead maintains their domain in a cave nestled within remote lava fields.

Yule Tane

The Yule Tane are a group of otherworldly beings from the Fey Realms. They touch the world from time to time, most often in the darkest and coldest times of the year. They are attuned to festivals and celebrations, with a keen sense for being mischief, menace, and even murder if their mysterious appetites are not appeased and their strict adherence to traditions and observances are not followed.
